title: Adi-lila, chapter 13. The Description of the Great Festival of the Lord’s Appearance
html:
“Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta”
Ādi-līlā
Chapter 13
The Description of the Great Festival of the Lord’s Appearance
(English translation from the Bengali, following the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition and the Anubhāṣya, 2026)

স প্রসীদতু চৈতন্যদেবো যস্য প্রসাদতঃ ৷
তল্লীলাবর্ণনে যোগ্যঃ সদ্যঃ স্যাদধমোঽপ্যয়ম্ ॥ ১ ॥

sa prasīdatu caitanya-
He may be gracious Caitanya-
devo yasya prasādataḥ
deva whose by the grace
tal-līlā-varṇane yogyaḥ
in describing His pastimes fit
sadyaḥ syād adhamo ’py ayam
at once may become fallen even this one

1May Śrī Caitanyadeva be gracious to me, for by His grace even one as fallen as I at once becomes fit to describe His pastimes.

জয় জয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য গৌরচন্দ্র ৷
জয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দ ॥ ২ ॥

jaya jaya śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya gauracandra
glory glory Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Gauracandra
jayādvaitacandra jaya jaya nityānanda
glory to Advaitacandra glory glory Nityānanda

2Glory, glory to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Gauracandra! Glory to Advaitacandra, and glory, glory to Nityānanda!

জয় জয় গদাধর জয় শ্রীনিবাস ৷
জয় মুকুন্দ বাসুদেব জয় হরিদাস ॥ ৩ ॥

jaya jaya gadādhara jaya śrīnivāsa
glory glory Gadādhara glory Śrīnivāsa
jaya mukunda vāsudeva jaya haridāsa
glory Mukunda Vāsudeva glory Haridāsa

3Glory, glory to Gadādhara, and glory to Śrīvāsa! Glory to Mukunda and Vāsudeva, and glory to Haridāsa!

জয় দামোদর-স্বরূপ জয় মুরারি গুপ্ত ৷
এই সব চন্দ্রোদয়ে তমঃ কৈল লুপ্ত ॥ ৪ ॥

jaya dāmodara-svarūpa jaya murāri gupta
glory Dāmodara-svarūpa glory Murāri Gupta
ei saba candrodaye tamaḥ kaila lupta
these all by the moons’ rising darkness made vanish

4Glory to Svarūpa Dāmodara, and glory to Murāri Gupta! These moons have risen and driven all darkness away.

জয় শ্রীচৈতন্যচন্দ্রের ভক্ত পূর্ণচন্দ্রগণ ৷
সবার প্রেম-জ্যোৎস্নায় উজ্জ্বল ত্রিভুবন ॥ ৫ ॥

jaya śrī-caitanyacandrera bhakta pūrṇacandra-gaṇa
glory of Śrī Caitanyacandra the devotees full moons
sabāra prema-jyotsnāya ujjvala tri-bhuvana
of all by the moonlight of love bright the three worlds

5Glory to the devotees of Śrī Caitanyacandra, who are full moons! The moonlight of their love makes the three worlds shine.1

এই ত’ কহিল গ্রন্থারম্ভে মুখবন্ধ ৷
এবে কহি চৈতন্য-লীলাক্রম-অনুবন্ধ ॥ ৬ ॥

ei ta’ kahila granthārambhe mukha-bandha
this indeed I have told at the book’s beginning the preface
ebe kahi caitanya-līlā-krama-anubandha
now I tell of Caitanya’s pastimes the sequence in order

6Thus I have given the preface at the beginning of the book. Now I shall tell the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya in their proper order.

প্রথমে ত’ সূত্ররূপে করিয়ে গণন ৷
পাছে তাহা বিস্তারি করিব বিবরণ ॥ ৭ ॥

prathame ta’ sūtra-rūpe kariye gaṇana
first indeed in the form of sūtras I make the count
pāche tāhā vistāri kariba vivaraṇa
afterwards that expanding I shall make the description

7First I shall list them briefly, as in sūtras; afterwards I shall describe them in detail.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য নবদ্বীপে অবতরি ৷
আটচল্লিশ বৎসর প্রকট বিহরি ॥ ৮ ॥

śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya navadvīpe avatari
Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya in Navadvīpa descending
āṭa-calliśa vatsara prakaṭa vihari
forty-eight years manifest sporting

8Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya descended in Navadvīpa, and for forty-eight years He enjoyed His pastimes before the eyes of the world.

চৌদ্দশত সাত শকে জন্মের প্রমাণ ৷
চৌদ্দশত পঞ্চান্নে হইল অন্তর্দ্ধান ॥ ৯ ॥

caudda-śata sāta śake janmera pramāṇa
fourteen hundred seven in the Śaka year of birth the record
caudda-śata pañcānne haila antarddhāna
in fourteen hundred fifty-five took place the disappearance

9His appearance is recorded in Śaka 1407 (1486), and He disappeared from the world in Śaka 1455 (1533).

চব্বিশ বৎসর প্রভু কৈল গৃহবাস ৷
নিরন্তর কৈল তাহে কীর্ত্তন-বিলাস ॥ ১০ ॥

cabbiśa vatsara prabhu kaila gṛha-vāsa
twenty-four years the Lord made household life
nirantara kaila tāhe kīrtana-vilāsa
constantly made there the delight of kīrtana

10For twenty-four years the Lord lived as a householder, and all that time He delighted in kīrtana.

চব্বিশ বৎসর-শেষে করিয়া সন্ন্যাস ৷
আর চব্বিশ বৎসর কৈল নীলাচলে বাস ॥ ১১ ॥

cabbiśa vatsara-śeṣe kariyā sannyāsa
of the twenty-fourth year at the end accepting sannyāsa
āra cabbiśa vatsara kaila nīlācale vāsa
another twenty-four years made in Nīlācala residence

11At the end of His twenty-fourth year He accepted sannyāsa, and for another twenty-four years He lived in Nīlācala.

তার মধ্যে ছয় বৎসর — গমনাগমন ৷
কভু দক্ষিণ, কভু গৌড়, কভু বৃন্দাবন ॥ ১২ ॥

tāra madhye chaya vatsara — gamanāgamana
of them within six years — going and coming
kabhu dakṣiṇa, kabhu gauḍa, kabhu vṛndāvana
sometimes the south, sometimes Gauḍa, sometimes Vṛndāvana

12Six of those years He spent journeying — now to the south, now to Gauḍa, now to Vṛndāvana.

অষ্টাদশ বৎসর রহিলা নীলাচলে ৷
কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-লীলামৃতে ভাসা’ল সকলে ॥ ১৩ ॥

aṣṭādaśa vatsara rahilā nīlācale
eighteen years remained in Nīlācala
kṛṣṇa-prema-līlāmṛte bhāsā’la sakale
in the nectar of the pastimes of love for Kṛṣṇa flooded everyone

13For eighteen years He stayed in Nīlācala, flooding everyone with the nectar of His pastimes of love for Kṛṣṇa.

গার্হস্থ্যে প্রভুর লীলা — ‘আদি’-লীলাখ্যান ৷
‘মধ্য’-‘অন্ত্য’-নামে — শেষলীলার দুই নাম ॥ ১৪ ॥

gārhasthye prabhura līlā — ‘ādi’-līlākhyāna
in household life the Lord’s pastimes — ‘ādi’-līlā is the name
‘madhya’-‘antya’-nāme — śeṣa-līlāra dui nāma
‘madhya’ ‘antya’ by name — of the later pastimes two names

14The Lord’s pastimes as a householder are called the Ādi-līlā, and His later pastimes bear two names, Madhya and Antya.

আদিলীলা-মধ্যে প্রভুর যতেক চরিত ৷
সূত্ররূপে মুরারি গুপ্ত করিলা গ্রথিত ॥ ১৫ ॥

ādi-līlā-madhye prabhura yateka carita
the Ādi-līlā within the Lord’s all deeds
sūtra-rūpe murāri gupta karilā grathita
in the form of sūtras Murāri Gupta made strung together

15Murāri Gupta recorded in sūtras all the Lord’s deeds in the Ādi-līlā.

প্রভুর যে-শেষ-লীলা স্বরূপ-দামোদর ৷
সূত্র করি’ গ্রন্থিলেন গ্রন্থের ভিতর ॥ ১৬ ॥

prabhura ye-śeṣa-līlā svarūpa-dāmodara
the Lord’s which later pastimes Svarūpa-dāmodara
sūtra kari’ granthilena granthera bhitara
sūtras making strung the book within

16Svarūpa Dāmodara set down the Lord’s later pastimes in brief notes and gathered them in his book.2

এই দুই জনের সূত্র দেখিয়া শুনিয়া ৷
বর্ণনা করেন বৈষ্ণব ক্রম যে করিয়া ॥ ১৭ ॥

ei dui janera sūtra dekhiyā śuniyā
these two persons’ sūtras seeing hearing
varṇanā karena vaiṣṇava krama ye kariyā
description make the Vaiṣṇavas the sequence which keeping

17Reading and hearing the notes of these two, the Vaiṣṇavas describe the Lord’s pastimes in their order.3

বাল্য, পৌগণ্ড, কৈশোর, যৌবন, — চারি ভেদ ৷
অতএব আদিখণ্ডে লীলা চারি ভেদ ॥ ১৮ ॥

bālya, paugaṇḍa, kaiśora, yauvana, — cāri bheda
childhood, boyhood, early youth, youth, — four divisions
ataeva ādi-khaṇḍe līlā cāri bheda
therefore in the first part the pastimes four divisions

18Childhood (bālya), boyhood (paugaṇḍa), early youth (kaiśora) and youth (yauvana) — these are the four ages, and so the Ādi-līlā falls into four divisions.

সর্ব্বসদ্গুণপূর্ণাং তাং বন্দে ফাল্গুনপূর্ণিমাম্ ৷
যস্যাং শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যোঽবতীর্ণঃ কৃষ্ণনামভিঃ ॥ ১৯ ॥

sarva-sad-guṇa-pūrṇāṁ tāṁ
with all good qualities full that
vande phālguna-pūrṇimām
I bow to the Phālguna full moon
yasyāṁ śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanyo
on which Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya
’vatīrṇaḥ kṛṣṇa-nāmabhiḥ
descended with the names of Kṛṣṇa

19I bow to that full moon of Phālguna, rich in every good quality, on which Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya descended together with the names of Kṛṣṇa.4

ফাল্গুনপূর্ণিমা-সন্ধ্যায় প্রভুর জন্মোদয় ৷
সেইকালে দৈবযোগে চন্দ্রের গ্রহণ হয় ॥ ২০ ॥

phālguna-pūrṇimā-sandhyāya prabhura janmodaya
on the Phālguna full moon in the evening the Lord’s birth arose
sei-kāle daiva-yoge candrera grahaṇa haya
at that time by providence of the moon eclipse takes place

20The Lord appeared on the evening of the Phālguna full moon, and at that very hour, as providence would have it, the moon was eclipsed.

‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ বলে লোক হরষিত হঞা ৷
জন্মিলা চৈতন্যপ্রভু ‘নাম’ জন্মাইয়া ॥ ২১ ॥

‘hari’ ‘hari’ bale loka haraṣita hañā
‘Hari’ ‘Hari’ say the people joyful becoming
janmilā caitanya-prabhu ‘nāma’ janmāiyā
was born Caitanya Prabhu the Name causing to be born

21The people were joyfully calling out, “Hari! Hari!” — and Caitanya Prabhu took birth, having first brought the Name to birth.

জন্ম-বাল্য-পৌগণ্ড-কৈশোর-যুবাকালে ৷
হরিনাম লওয়াইলা প্রভু নানা-ছলে ॥ ২২ ॥

janma-bālya-paugaṇḍa-kaiśora-yuvā-kāle
at birth, in childhood, boyhood, early youth, youth
hari-nāma laoyāilā prabhu nānā-chale
the name of Hari made take the Lord by various pretexts

22At His birth, in childhood, boyhood, early youth and youth, the Lord found one pretext or another to make people take the name of Hari.

বাল্যভাব-ছলে প্রভু করেন ক্রন্দন ৷
‘কৃষ্ণ’ ‘হরি’ নাম শুনি’ রহয়ে রোদন ॥ ২৩ ॥

bālya-bhāva-chale prabhu karena krandana
of a child’s mood on the pretext the Lord does crying
‘kṛṣṇa’ ‘hari’ nāma śuni’ rahaye rodana
‘Kṛṣṇa’ ‘Hari’ the names hearing stops weeping

23In the guise of an ordinary infant the Lord would cry, but the moment He heard the names “Kṛṣṇa” and “Hari”, He would fall silent.5

অতএব ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ বলে নারীগণ ৷
দেখিতে আইসে যেবা সর্ব্ব-বন্ধুজন ॥ ২৪ ॥

ataeva ‘hari’ ‘hari’ bale nārīgaṇa
therefore ‘Hari’ ‘Hari’ say the women
dekhite āise yebā sarva-bandhu jana
to see come who all friends and kin

24So all the women among His friends and kin who came to see Him would chant, “Hari! Hari!”

‘গৌরহরি’ বলি’ তারে হাসে সর্ব্ব নারী ৷
অতএব হৈল তাঁর নাম ‘গৌরহরি’ ॥ ২৫ ॥

‘gaurahari’ bali’ tāre hāse sarva nārī
‘Gaurahari’ calling Him laugh all the women
ataeva haila tām̐ra nāma ‘gaurahari’
therefore became His name ‘Gaurahari’

25Laughing, the women all called Him “Gaurahari”, and so Gaurahari became His name.

বাল্য-বয়স — যাবৎ হাতে খড়ি দিল ৷
পৌগণ্ড-বয়স — যাবৎ বিবাহ না কৈল ॥ ২৬ ॥

bālya-vayasa — yāvat hāte khaḍi dila
childhood age — until in His hand chalk was given
paugaṇḍa-vayasa — yāvat vivāha nā kaila
boyhood age — until marriage not was made

26His childhood lasted until the chalk was put in His hand for His first lesson; His boyhood, until He married.

বিবাহ করিলে হৈল নবীন যৌবন ৷
সর্ব্বত্র লওয়াইল প্রভু নাম-সঙ্কীর্ত্তন ॥ ২৭ ॥

vivāha karile haila navīna yauvana
marriage having made began fresh youth
sarvatra laoyāila prabhu nāma-saṅkīrtana
everywhere made take the Lord the saṅkīrtana of the name

27With His marriage began the bloom of youth, and everywhere the Lord led people to chant the name together.

পৌগণ্ড-বয়সে পড়েন, পড়ান শিষ্যগণে ৷
সর্ব্বত্র করেন কৃষ্ণনামের ব্যাখ্যানে ॥ ২৮ ॥

paugaṇḍa-vayase paḍena, paḍāna śiṣyagaṇe
in boyhood age He studies, teaches the pupils
sarvatra karena kṛṣṇa-nāmera vyākhyāne
everywhere makes of Kṛṣṇa’s name the explanation

28In His boyhood He studied and also taught pupils, and everywhere He explained the name of Kṛṣṇa.

সূত্র-বৃত্তি-টীকায় কৃষ্ণনামের তাৎপর্য্য ৷
শিষ্যের প্রতীত হয়, — সবার আশ্চর্য্য ॥ ২৯ ॥

sūtra-vṛtti-ṭīkāya kṛṣṇanāmera tātparya
in sūtra, gloss, commentary of Kṛṣṇa’s name the purport
śiṣyera pratīta haya, — sabāra āścarya
to the pupils clear becomes, — to all a wonder

29He showed that the purport of every sūtra, gloss and commentary was the name of Kṛṣṇa, and His pupils came to see it plainly — a wonder to all.6

যারে দেখে, তারে কহে, — কহ কৃষ্ণনাম ৷
কৃষ্ণ-নামে ভাসাইল নবদ্বীপ-গ্রাম ॥ ৩০ ॥

yāre dekhe, tāre kahe, — kaha kṛṣṇa-nāma
whom He sees, to him says — say Kṛṣṇa’s name
kṛṣṇa-nāme bhāsāila navadvīpa-grāma
with Kṛṣṇa’s name flooded Navadvīpa town

30Whomever He met He would tell, “Chant the name of Kṛṣṇa!” — and He flooded the town of Navadvīpa with Kṛṣṇa’s name.

কিশোর-বয়সে আরম্ভিলা সংকীর্ত্তন ৷
রাত্র-দিনে প্রেমে নৃত্য, সঙ্গে ভক্তগণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

kiśora-vayase ārambhilā saṁkīrtana
in early youth age began saṅkīrtana
rātra-dine preme nṛtya, saṅge bhakta-gaṇa
night and day in love dancing, with the devotees

31In His early youth He began the saṅkīrtana, dancing in love night and day together with His devotees.

নগরে নগরে ভ্রমে কীর্ত্তন করিয়া ৷
ভাসাইল ত্রিভুবন প্রেমভক্তি দিয়া ॥ ৩২ ॥

nagare nagare bhrame kīrtana kariyā
from town to town wanders kīrtana doing
bhāsāila tri-bhuvana prema-bhakti diyā
flooded the three worlds love and devotion giving

32He wandered from town to town singing kīrtana, and flooded the three worlds with loving devotion.

চব্বিশ বৎসর ঐছে নবদ্বীপ-গ্রামে ৷
লওয়াইলা সর্ব্বলোকে কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-নামে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

cabbiśa vatsara aiche navadvīpa-grāme
twenty-four years thus in Navadvīpa town
laoyāilā sarva-loke kṛṣṇa-prema-nāme
made take all people to love for Kṛṣṇa and the name

33Thus for twenty-four years in Navadvīpa He led everyone to the name of Kṛṣṇa and to love for Him.

চব্বিশ বৎসর ছিলা করিয়া সন্ন্যাস ৷
ভক্তগণ লঞা কৈলা নীলাচলে বাস ॥ ৩৪ ॥

cabbiśa vatsara chilā kariyā sannyāsa
twenty-four years He stayed having accepted sannyāsa
bhakta-gaṇa lañā kailā nīlācale vāsa
the devotees taking along made in Nīlācala residence

34After accepting sannyāsa He remained twenty-four years more, living with His devotees in Nīlācala.

তার মধ্যে নীলাচলে ছয় বৎসর ৷
নৃত্য, গীত, প্রেমভক্তি-দান নিরন্তর ॥ ৩৫ ॥

tāra madhye nīlācale chaya vatsara
of them within in Nīlācala six years
nṛtya, gīta, premabhakti-dāna nirantara
dancing, singing, the gift of loving devotion unceasing

35Of those years in Nīlācala, He spent six in ceaseless dancing and singing, giving away loving devotion.7

সেতুবন্ধ, আর গৌড়-ব্যাপি বৃন্দাবন ৷
প্রেম-নাম প্রচারিয়া করিলা ভ্রমণ ॥ ৩৬ ॥

setubandha, āra gauḍa-vyāpi vṛndāvana
Setubandha, and pervading Gauḍa Vṛndāvana
prema-nāma pracāriyā karilā bhramaṇa
love and the name preaching made journeying

36He journeyed as far as Setubandha in the south, through Gauḍa and on to Vṛndāvana, spreading the holy name and love wherever He went.

এই ‘মধ্যলীলা’ নাম — লীলা-মুখ্যধাম ৷
শেষ অষ্টাদশ বর্ষ — ‘অন্ত্যলীলা’ নাম ॥ ৩৭ ॥

ei ‘madhya-līlā’ nāma — līlā-mukhyadhāma
this ‘madhya-līlā’ by name — of the pastimes the chief abode
śeṣa aṣṭādaśa varṣa — ‘antya-līlā’ nāma
the last eighteen years — ‘antya-līlā’ by name

37These six years are called the Madhya-līlā, the very heart of His pastimes; the last eighteen years are called the Antya-līlā.

তার মধ্যে ছয় বৎসর ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ৷
প্রেমভক্তি লওয়াইল নৃত্যগীত-রঙ্গে ॥ ৩৮ ॥

tāra madhye chaya vatsara bhaktagaṇa-saṅge
of them within six years with the devotees
prema-bhakti laoyāila nṛtya-gīta-raṅge
loving devotion made take in the joy of dancing and singing

38For six of those years, in the joy of dancing and singing with His devotees, He led people to loving devotion.

দ্বাদশ বৎসর শেষ রহিলা নীলাচলে ৷
প্রেমাবস্থা শিখাইলা আস্বাদন-চ্ছলে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

dvādaśa vatsara śeṣa rahilā nīlācale
twelve years the last remained in Nīlācala
premāvasthā śikhāilā āsvādana-cchale
the states of love taught on the pretext of tasting

39The last twelve years He stayed in Nīlācala, and, tasting love Himself, He taught everyone its highest states.8

রাত্রি-দিবসে কৃষ্ণবিরহ-স্ফুরণ ৷
উন্মাদের চেষ্টা করে প্রলাপ-বচন ॥ ৪০ ॥

rātri-divase kṛṣṇa-viraha-sphuraṇa
night and day of separation from Kṛṣṇa the welling up
unmādera ceṣṭā kare pralāpa-vacana
of a madman the ways makes, incoherent words

40Night and day the pain of separation from Kṛṣṇa welled up in Him; He behaved like one mad and spoke in broken, raving words.

শ্রীরাধার প্রলাপ যৈছে উদ্ধব-দর্শনে ৷
সেইমত উন্মাদ-প্রলাপ করে রাত্রিদিনে ॥ ৪১ ॥

śrī-rādhāra pralāpa yaiche uddhava-darśane
Śrī Rādhā’s raving as on seeing Uddhava
seimata unmāda-pralāpa kare rātridine
just so mad raving makes night and day

41Just as Śrī Rādhā raved on seeing Uddhava, so He raved in His divine madness night and day.

বিদ্যাপতি, জয়দেব, চণ্ডীদাসের গীত ৷
আস্বাদেন রামানন্দ-স্বরূপ-সহিত ॥ ৪২ ॥

vidyāpati, jayadeva, caṇḍīdāsera gīta
Vidyāpati, Jayadeva, of Caṇḍīdāsa the songs
āsvādena rāmānanda-svarūpa-sahita
He relishes Rāmānanda Svarūpa together with

42With Rāmānanda and Svarūpa He relished the songs of Vidyāpati, Jayadeva and Caṇḍīdāsa.9

কৃষ্ণের বিয়োগে যত প্রেম-চেষ্টিত ৷
আস্বাদিয়া পূর্ণ কৈল আপন-বাঞ্ছিত ॥ ৪৩ ॥

kṛṣṇera viyoge yata prema-ceṣṭita
of Kṛṣṇa in separation all the ways of love
āsvādiyā pūrṇa kaila āpana-vāñchita
tasting fulfilled made His own desire

43Tasting all the ways of love in separation from Kṛṣṇa, He fulfilled His own desire.

অনন্ত চৈতন্যলীলা ক্ষুদ্র জীব হঞা ৷
কে বলিতে পারে, তাহা বিস্তার করিয়া ॥ ৪৪ ॥

ananta caitanya-līlā kṣudra jīva hañā
endless Caitanya’s pastimes; a tiny soul being
ke balite pāre, tāhā vistāra kariyā
who to tell can, them in full making

44Śrī Caitanya’s pastimes are endless. How could a tiny soul tell them in full?

সূত্র করি’ গণে যদি আপনে অনন্ত ৷
সহস্র-বদনে তিঁহো নাহি পায় অন্ত ॥ ৪৫ ॥

sūtra kari’ gaṇe yadi āpane ananta
in sūtras making counts if Himself Ananta
sahasra-vadane tim̐ho nāhi pāya anta
with a thousand mouths He not reaches the end

45Even if Ananta Himself were to count them in brief, with all His thousand mouths He would never reach the end.

দামোদর-স্বরূপ, আর গুপ্ত মুরারি ৷
মুখ্যমুখ্যলীলা সূত্রে লিখিয়াছে বিচারি’ ॥ ৪৬ ॥

dāmodara-svarūpa, āra gupta murāri
Dāmodara-svarūpa, and Gupta Murāri
mukhya-mukhya-līlā sūtre likhiyāche vicāri’
the chief and foremost pastimes in sūtras have written after weighing

46Svarūpa Dāmodara and Murāri Gupta weighed them carefully and wrote down the chief pastimes in brief.

সেই অনুসারে লিখি লীলা-সূত্রগণ ৷
বিস্তারি’ বর্ণিয়াছেন তাহা দাস-বৃন্দাবন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

sei anusāre likhi līlā-sūtragaṇa
that following I write the sūtras of the pastimes
vistāri’ varṇiyāchena tāhā dāsa-vṛndāvana
in detail has described them dāsa-Vṛndāvana

47Following them, I write these pastimes in brief, and Vṛndāvana dāsa has described them in detail.10

চৈতন্য-লীলার ব্যাস, — দাস বৃন্দাবন ৷
মধুর করিয়া লীলা করিলা রচন ॥ ৪৮ ॥

caitanya-līlāra vyāsa, — dāsa vṛndāvana
of Caitanya’s pastimes the Vyāsa — dāsa Vṛndāvana
madhura kariyā līlā karilā racana
sweet making the pastimes made composition

48Vṛndāvana dāsa is the Vyāsa of Śrī Caitanya’s pastimes, and he set them down with great sweetness.

গ্রন্থ-বিস্তার-ভয়ে ছাড়িলা যে যে স্থানে ৷
সেই সেই স্থানে কিছু করিব ব্যাখানে ॥ ৪৯ ॥

grantha-vistāra-bhaye chāḍilā ye ye sthāne
of the book the expansion fearing left out which which places
sei sei sthāne kichu kariba vyākhāne
those those places some I shall make explanation

49Fearing that his book would grow too long, he left out certain parts, and of these I shall say something.

প্রভুর লীলামৃত তিঁহো কৈল আস্বাদন ৷
তাঁর ভুক্ত-শেষ কিছু করিয়ে চর্ব্বণ ॥ ৫০ ॥

prabhura līlāmṛta tim̐ho kaila āsvādana
the Lord’s nectar of pastimes he made tasting
tām̐ra bhukta-śeṣa kichu kariye carvaṇa
his food’s remnants some I make chewing

50He has tasted the nectar of the Lord’s pastimes; I only savour a few morsels of what he has left.

আদিলীলা-সূত্র লিখি, শুন, ভক্তগণ ৷
সংক্ষেপে লিখিয়ে সম্যক্ না যায় লিখন ॥ ৫১ ॥

ādi-līlā-sūtra likhi, śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
the Ādi-līlā sūtras I write, hear, devotees
saṁkṣepe likhiye samyak nā yāya likhana
in brief I write; fully not goes writing

51Listen, O devotees: I write the Ādi-līlā in brief, for it cannot be written in full.

কোন বাঞ্ছা পূরণ লাগি’ ব্রজেন্দ্রকুমার ৷
অবতীর্ণ হৈতে মনে করিলা বিচার ॥ ৫২ ॥

kona vāñchā pūraṇa lāgi’ vrajendra-kumāra
a certain desire fulfilment for the sake of the son of the king of Vraja
avatīrṇa haite mane karilā vicāra
to descend in His mind made consideration

52To fulfil a certain desire, the son of the king of Vraja resolved in His mind to descend.

আগে অবতারিলা যে যে গুরু-পরিবার ৷
সংক্ষেপে কহিয়ে, কহা না যায় বিস্তার ॥ ৫৩ ॥

āge avatārilā ye ye guru-parivāra
first caused to descend which which the family of elders
saṁkṣepe kahiye, kahā nā yāya vistāra
in brief I tell; to tell not goes in full

53First He sent down His elders and kin. I shall name them in brief, for they cannot all be told in full.

শ্রীশচী-জগন্নাথ, শ্রীমাধবপুরী ৷
কেশব ভারতী, আর শ্রীঈশ্বর পুরী ॥ ৫৪ ॥

অদ্বৈত আচার্য্য, আর পণ্ডিত শ্রীবাস ৷
আচার্য্যরত্ন, বিদ্যানিধি, ঠাকুর হরিদাস ॥ ৫৫ ॥

śrī-śacī-jagannātha, śrī-mādhava-purī
Śrī Śacī Jagannātha, Śrī Mādhava Purī
keśava bhāratī, āra śrī-īśvara purī
Keśava Bhāratī, and Śrī Īśvara Purī
advaita ācārya, āra paṇḍita śrīvāsa
Advaita Ācārya, and Paṇḍita Śrīvāsa
ācāryaratna, vidyānidhi, ṭhākura haridāsa
Ācāryaratna, Vidyānidhi, Ṭhākura Haridāsa

54–55Śrī Śacī and Jagannātha, Śrī Mādhava Purī, Keśava Bhāratī and Śrī Īśvara Purī, Advaita Ācārya and Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita, Ācāryaratna, Vidyānidhi and Ṭhākura Haridāsa.

শ্রীহট্ট-নিবাসী শ্রীউপেন্দ্রমিশ্র-নাম ৷
বৈষ্ণব, পণ্ডিত, ধনী, সদ্গুণ-প্রধান ॥ ৫৬ ॥

śrīhaṭṭa-nivāsī śrī-upendra-miśra-nāma
of Śrīhaṭṭa resident Śrī Upendra Miśra by name
vaiṣṇava, paṇḍita, dhanī, sad-guṇa-pradhāna
a Vaiṣṇava, learned, wealthy, in good qualities foremost

56In Śrīhaṭṭa lived Śrī Upendra Miśra — a Vaiṣṇava, learned and wealthy, and rich in every virtue.11

সপ্ত মিশ্র তাঁর পুত্র — সপ্ত ঋষীশ্বর ৷
কংসারি, পরমানন্দ, পদ্মনাভ, সর্ব্বেশ্বর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

জগন্নাথ, জনার্দ্দন, ত্রৈলোক্যনাথ ৷
নদীয়াতে গঙ্গাবাস কৈল জগন্নাথ ॥ ৫৮ ॥

sapta miśra tām̐ra putra — sapta ṛṣīśvara
seven Miśras his sons — seven great sages
kaṁsāri, paramānanda, padmanābha, sarveśvara
Kaṁsāri, Paramānanda, Padmanābha, Sarveśvara
jagannātha, janārdana, trailokyanātha
Jagannātha, Janārdana, Trailokyanātha
nadīyāte gaṅgā-vāsa kaila jagannātha
in Nadīyā by the Gaṅgā residence made Jagannātha

57–58His seven sons, the seven Miśras, were like seven great sages: Kaṁsāri, Paramānanda, Padmanābha, Sarveśvara, Jagannātha, Janārdana and Trailokyanātha. Jagannātha made his home by the Gaṅgā in Nadīyā.

জগন্নাথ মিশ্রবর — পদবী ‘পুরন্দর’ ৷
নন্দ-বসুদেব পূর্ব্বে সদ্গুণ-সাগর ॥ ৫৯ ॥

jagannātha miśravara — padavī ‘purandara’
Jagannātha the best of the Miśras — title ‘Purandara’
nanda-vasudeva pūrve sadguṇa-sāgara
Nanda Vasudeva formerly, of good qualities an ocean

59Jagannātha, the best of the Miśras, bore the title Purandara. This ocean of virtues had once been Nanda and Vasudeva.12

তাঁর পত্নী ‘শচী’-নাম, পতিব্রতা সতী ৷
যাঁর পিতা ‘নীলাম্বর’ নাম চক্রবর্ত্তী ॥ ৬০ ॥

tām̐ra patnī ‘śacī’-nāma, pativratā satī
his wife Śacī by name, devoted to her husband, chaste
yām̐ra pitā ‘nīlāmbara’ nāma cakravartī
whose father Nīlāmbara by name Cakravartī

60His wife, named Śacī, was chaste and wholly devoted to her husband; her father was Nīlāmbara Cakravartī.13

রাঢ়দেশে জন্মিলা ঠাকুর নিত্যানন্দ ৷
গঙ্গাদাস পণ্ডিত, গুপ্ত মুরারি, মুকুন্দ ॥ ৬১ ॥

rāḍhadeśe janmilā ṭhākura nityānanda
in the Rāḍha country were born Ṭhākura Nityānanda
gaṅgādāsa paṇḍita, gupta murāri, mukunda
Gaṅgādāsa Paṇḍita, Gupta Murāri, Mukunda

61In the land of Rāḍha were born Ṭhākura Nityānanda, Gaṅgādāsa Paṇḍita, Murāri Gupta and Mukunda.

অসংখ্য ভক্তের করাইলা অবতার ৷
শেষে অবতীর্ণ হৈলা ব্রজেন্দ্রকুমার ॥ ৬২ ॥

asaṁkhya bhaktera karāilā avatāra
countless devotees’ caused descent
śeṣe avatīrṇa hailā vrajendra-kumāra
at last descended became the son of the king of Vraja

62He sent countless devotees down before Him, and last of all the son of the king of Vraja descended Himself.

প্রভুর আবির্ভাবপূর্ব্বে যত বৈষ্ণবগণ ৷
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য্যের স্থানে করেন গমন ॥ ৬৩ ॥

prabhura āvirbhāva-pūrve yata vaiṣṇava-gaṇa
the Lord’s appearance before all the Vaiṣṇavas
advaita-ācāryera sthāne karena gamana
of Advaita Ācārya to the place make going

63Before the Lord appeared, all the Vaiṣṇavas would gather at the home of Advaita Ācārya.

গীতা-ভাগবত কহে আচার্য্য-গোসাঞি ৷
জ্ঞান-কর্ম্ম নিন্দি’ করে ভক্তির বড়াই ॥ ৬৪ ॥

gītā-bhāgavata kahe ācārya-gosāñi
the Gītā the Bhāgavata speaks Ācārya Gosāñi
jñāna-karma nindi’ kare bhaktira baḍāi
knowledge work decrying makes of bhakti the glory

64There Ācārya Gosāñi expounded the Gītā and the Bhāgavata, decrying the paths of knowledge and fruitive work and extolling bhakti.

সর্ব্বশাস্ত্রে কহে কৃষ্ণভক্তির ব্যাখ্যান ৷
জ্ঞান, যোগ, তপো-ধর্ম্ম নাহি মানে আন ॥ ৬৫ ॥

sarva-śāstre kahe kṛṣṇa-bhaktira vyākhyāna
in all scriptures speaks of devotion to Kṛṣṇa the explanation
jñāna, yoga, tapo-dharma nāhi māne āna
knowledge, yoga, austerity, dharma not accepts other

65He showed that all the scriptures speak of devotion to Kṛṣṇa, and would accept no other path — not knowledge, yoga, austerity or ritual dharma.14

তাঁর সঙ্গে আনন্দ করে বৈষ্ণবের গণ ৷
কৃষ্ণকথা, কৃষ্ণপূজা, নামসংকীর্ত্তন ॥ ৬৬ ॥

tām̐ra saṅge ānanda kare vaiṣṇavera gaṇa
His company in joy make the Vaiṣṇavas’ host
kṛṣṇa-kathā, kṛṣṇa-pūjā, nāma-saṁkīrtana
talk of Kṛṣṇa, worship of Kṛṣṇa, the saṅkīrtana of the name

66In His company the Vaiṣṇavas delighted in talks of Kṛṣṇa, worship of Kṛṣṇa and the saṅkīrtana of the holy name.

কিন্তু সর্ব্বলোক দেখি’ কৃষ্ণবহির্ম্মুখ ৷
বিষয়ে নিমগ্ন লোক দেখি’ পায় দুঃখ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

kintu sarva-loka dekhi’ kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha
but all people seeing turned away from Kṛṣṇa
viṣaye nimagna loka dekhi’ pāya duḥkha
in sense objects sunk people seeing gets sorrow

67But when He saw that all people had turned away from Kṛṣṇa and were sunk in worldly things, He grieved.

লোকের নিস্তার-হেতু করেন চিন্তন ৷
কেমতে এ সর্ব্বলোকের হইবে তারণ ॥ ৬৮ ॥

lokera nistāra-hetu karena cintana
of the people deliverance for makes thinking
kemate e sarva-lokera haibe tāraṇa
how these all people’s will be deliverance

68He pondered how they might be delivered: how could all these people be saved?

কৃষ্ণ অবতরি’ করেন ভক্তির বিস্তার ৷
তবে ত’ সকল লোকের হইবে নিস্তার ॥ ৬৯ ॥

kṛṣṇa avatari’ karena bhaktira vistāra
Kṛṣṇa descending makes of bhakti the spreading
tabe ta’ sakala lokera haibe nistāra
then indeed all people’s will be deliverance

69“If Kṛṣṇa descends and spreads bhakti, then indeed all people will be delivered.”

কৃষ্ণ অবতারিতে আচার্য্য প্রতিজ্ঞা করিয়া ৷
কৃষ্ণপূজা করে তুলসী-গঙ্গাজল দিয়া ॥ ৭০ ॥

kṛṣṇa avatārite ācārya pratijñā kariyā
Kṛṣṇa to bring down the Ācārya a vow making
kṛṣṇa-pūjā kare tulasī-gaṅgājala diyā
worship of Kṛṣṇa does tulasī Gaṅgā water offering

70Vowing to bring Kṛṣṇa down, the Ācārya worshipped Him with tulasī and Gaṅgā water.

কৃষ্ণের আহ্বান করে সঘন হুঙ্কার ৷
হুঙ্কারে আকৃষ্ট হৈলা ব্রজেন্দ্রকুমার ॥ ৭১ ॥

kṛṣṇera āhvāna kare saghana huṅkāra
Kṛṣṇa’s calling does with repeated roars
huṅkāre ākṛṣṭa hailā vrajendra-kumāra
by the roars attracted became the son of the king of Vraja

71He called to Kṛṣṇa with roar upon roar, and those roars drew the son of the king of Vraja.15

জগন্নাথমিশ্র-পত্নী শচীর উদরে ৷
অষ্ট কন্যা ক্রমে হৈল, জন্মি’ জন্মি’ মরে ॥ ৭২ ॥

jagannātha-miśra-patnī śacīra udare
Jagannātha Miśra’s wife Śacī’s in the womb
aṣṭa kanyā krame haila, janmi’ janmi’ mare
eight daughters one after another came, being born being born die

72Eight daughters were born one after another to Śacī, the wife of Jagannātha Miśra, and each died soon after her birth.

অপত্য-বিরহে মিশ্রের দুঃখী হৈল মন ৷
পুত্র লাগি’ আরাধিল বিষ্ণুর চরণ ॥ ৭৩ ॥

apatya-virahe miśrera duḥkhī haila mana
children’s loss in Miśra’s sorrowful became mind
putra lāgi’ ārādhila viṣṇura caraṇa
a son for worshipped Viṣṇu’s feet

73Grieving at the loss of his children, Miśra worshipped the feet of Viṣṇu, praying for a son.

তবে পুত্র জনমিল ‘বিশ্বরূপ’ নাম ৷
মহা-গুণবান্ তেঁহ — ‘বলদেব’-ধাম ॥ ৭৪ ॥

tabe putra janamila ‘viśvarūpa’ nāma
then a son was born ‘Viśvarūpa’ by name
mahā-guṇavān tem̐ha — ‘baladeva’-dhāma
greatly virtuous He — the abode of ‘Baladeva’

74Then a son was born, named Viśvarūpa. He was rich in great virtues, a manifestation of Baladeva.

বলদেব-প্রকাশ — পরব্যোমে ‘সঙ্কর্ষণ’ ৷
তেঁহ — বিশ্বের উপাদান-নিমিত্ত-কারণ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

baladeva-prakāśa — para-vyome ‘saṅkarṣaṇa’
Baladeva’s manifestation — in the spiritual sky ‘Saṅkarṣaṇa’
tem̐ha — viśvera upādāna-nimitta-kāraṇa
He — of the universe the material efficient cause

75Baladeva’s manifestation in the spiritual sky is Saṅkarṣaṇa, and He is both the material and the efficient cause of the universe.16

তাঁহা বই বিশ্বে কিছু নাহি দেখি আর ৷
অতএব ‘বিশ্বরূপ’ নাম যে তাঁহার ॥ ৭৬ ॥

tām̐hā bai viśve kichu nāhi dekhi āra
Him apart from in the universe anything not I see else
ataeva ‘viśvarūpa’ nāma ye tām̐hāra
therefore ‘Viśvarūpa’ the name indeed His

76Apart from Him I see nothing in the universe, and so He is called Viśvarūpa, “He whose form is the universe”.

নৈতচ্চিত্রং ভগবতি হ্যনন্তে জগদীশ্বরে ৷
ওতং প্রোতমিদং যস্মিন্ তন্তুষ্বঙ্গ যথা পটঃ ॥ ৭৭ ॥

naitac citraṁ bhagavati
not this wonderful in Bhagavān
hy anante jagad-īśvare
indeed in the unlimited in the Lord of the universe
otaṁ protam idaṁ yasmin
woven lengthwise crosswise this in whom
tantuṣv aṅga yathā paṭaḥ
on threads O dear one as cloth

77“O King, this is no wonder for Bhagavān, the unlimited Lord of the universe, in whom this whole world is woven, warp and weft, like cloth upon its threads.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.15.35)17

অতএব প্রভু তাঁরে বলে, ‘বড় ভাই’ ৷
কৃষ্ণ, বলরাম দুই — চৈতন্য, নিতাই ॥ ৭৮ ॥

ataeva prabhu tām̐re bale, ‘baḍa bhāi’
therefore the Lord Him calls ‘elder brother’
kṛṣṇa, balarāma dui — caitanya, nitāi
Kṛṣṇa, Balarāma the two — Caitanya, Nitāi

78That is why the Lord called Him His elder brother. Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma — these two are Caitanya and Nitāi.18

পুত্র পাঞা দম্পতি হৈলা আনন্দিত মন ৷
বিশেষে সেবন করে গোবিন্দচরণ ॥ ৭৯ ॥

putra pāñā dampati hailā ānandita mana
a son obtaining the couple became joyful at heart
viśeṣe sevana kare govinda-caraṇa
especially service do of Govinda’s feet

79Blessed with a son, the couple rejoiced and served the feet of Govinda with still greater devotion.

চৌদ্দশত ছয় শকে শেষ মাঘ-মাসে ৷
জগন্নাথ-শচীর দেহে কৃষ্ণের প্রবেশে ॥ ৮০ ॥

caudda-śata chaya śake śeṣa māgha-māse
fourteen hundred six in the Śaka year at the end in the month of Māgha
jagannātha-śacīra dehe kṛṣṇera praveśe
of Jagannātha Śacī into the bodies of Kṛṣṇa the entering

80At the end of the month of Māgha in Śaka 1406, Kṛṣṇa entered the bodies of Jagannātha and Śacī.19

মিশ্র কহে শচী-স্থানে, — দেখি অন্য রীত ৷
জ্যোতির্ম্ময় দেহ, গেহ লক্ষ্মী-অধিষ্ঠিত ॥ ৮১ ॥

miśra kahe śacī-sthāne, — dekhi anya rīta
Miśra says to Śacī — I see a different way
jyotirmaya deha, geha lakṣmī-adhiṣṭhita
effulgent the body, the house by Lakṣmī presided over

81Miśra said to Śacī, “I see something wonderful. Your body is radiant, and our house has become the abode of Lakṣmī.

যাঁহা তাঁহা সর্ব্বলোক করয়ে সম্মান ৷
ঘরে পাঠাইয়া দেয় ধন, বস্ত্র, ধান ॥ ৮২ ॥

yām̐hā tām̐hā sarva-loka karaye sammāna
wherever wherever all people do honour
ghare pāṭhāiyā deya dhana, vastra, dhāna
to the house sending give wealth, cloth, rice

82Wherever I go, people honour me, and they send wealth, clothes and rice to our house.”

শচী কহে, — মুঞি দেখোঁ আকাশ-উপরে ৷
দিব্যমূর্ত্তি লোক আসি’ স্তুতি হেন করে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

śacī kahe, — muñi dekhom̐ ākāśa-upare
Śacī says — I see in the sky above
divya-mūrti loka āsi’ stuti hena kare
of divine forms beings coming praises thus make

83Śacī replied, “And I see beings of divine form appear in the sky above and offer prayers.”

জগন্নাথ মিশ্র কহে, — স্বপ্ন যে দেখিল ৷
জ্যোতির্ম্ময়-ধাম মোর হৃদয়ে পশিল ॥ ৮৪ ॥

jagannātha miśra kahe, — svapna ye dekhila
Jagannātha Miśra says — a dream which I saw
jyotirmaya-dhāma mora hṛdaye paśila
an effulgent abode my into the heart entered

84Jagannātha Miśra said, “I had a dream: a radiant abode entered my heart.

আমার হৃদয় হৈতে তোমার হৃদয়ে ৷
হেন বুঝি, জন্মিবেন কোন মহাশয়ে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

āmāra hṛdaya haite tomāra hṛdaye
my heart from into your heart
hena bujhi, janmibena kona mahāśaye
so I understand, will be born some great soul

85From my heart it passed into yours. So I understand that some great soul is to be born.”

এত বলি’ দুঁহে রহে হরষিত হঞা ৷
শালগ্রাম সেবা করে বিশেষ করিয়া ॥ ৮৬ ॥

eta bali’ dum̐he rahe haraṣita hañā
thus saying the two remain joyful becoming
śālagrāma sevā kare viśeṣa kariyā
the śālagrāma service do special making

86Speaking thus, the two were filled with joy, and they served the śālagrāma with special care.

হৈতে হৈতে হৈল গর্ভ ত্রয়োদশ মাস ৷
তথাপি ভূমিষ্ঠ নহে, — মিশ্রের হৈল ত্রাস ॥ ৮৭ ॥

haite haite haila garbha trayodaśa māsa
going on going on became the pregnancy thirteen months
tathāpi bhūmiṣṭha nahe, — miśrera haila trāsa
even so born not — Miśra’s became fear

87The months went by until the thirteenth had come, yet still the child was not born, and Miśra grew afraid.

নীলাম্বর চক্রবর্ত্তী কহিল গণিয়া ৷
এই মাসে পুত্র হবে শুভক্ষণ পাঞা ॥ ৮৮ ॥

nīlāmbara cakravartī kahila gaṇiyā
Nīlāmbara Cakravartī said calculating
ei māse putra habe śubha-kṣaṇa pāñā
in this month a son will be an auspicious moment obtaining

88Nīlāmbara Cakravartī made his calculations and said, “A son will be born this month, at an auspicious moment.”

চৌদ্দশত সাত শকে মাস যে ফাল্গুন ৷
পৌর্ণমাসীর সন্ধ্যাকালে হৈলে শুভক্ষণ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

caudda-śata sāta śake māsa ye phālguna
fourteen hundred seven in the Śaka year the month which Phālguna
paurṇamāsīra sandhyā-kāle haile śubha-kṣaṇa
of the full moon at evening time came the auspicious moment

89In Śaka 1407, in the month of Phālguna, the auspicious moment came on the evening of the full moon.

সিংহ-রাশি, সিংহ-লগ্ন, উচ্চ গ্রহগণ ৷
ষড়্বর্গ, অষ্টবর্গ, সর্ব্ব সুলক্ষণ ॥ ৯০ ॥

siṁha-rāśi, siṁha-lagna, ucca graha-gaṇa
Leo the sign, Leo the ascendant, exalted the planets
ṣaḍ-varga, aṣṭa-varga, sarva sulakṣaṇa
the six divisions, the eight divisions, all auspicious signs

90The moon was in Leo, Leo was rising and the planets were exalted; the six divisions and the eight divisions all showed auspicious signs.20

অ-কলঙ্ক গৌরচন্দ্র দিলা দরশন ৷
স-কলঙ্ক চন্দ্রে আর কোন্ প্রয়োজন ॥ ৯১ ॥

a-kalaṅka gauracandra dilā daraśana
spotless Gauracandra gave sight of Himself
sa-kalaṅka candre āra kon prayojana
spotted in the moon further what need

91Once the spotless moon Gauracandra had shown Himself, what further need was there of the spotted moon?

এত জানি’ চন্দ্রে রাহু করিলা গ্রহণ ৷
‘কৃষ্ণ’ ‘কৃষ্ণ’ ‘হরি’নামে ভাসে ত্রিভুবন ॥ ৯২ ॥

eta jāni’ candre rāhu karilā grahaṇa
this knowing the moon Rāhu made seizing
‘kṛṣṇa’ ‘kṛṣṇa’ ‘hari’nāme bhāse tri-bhuvana
‘Kṛṣṇa’ ‘Kṛṣṇa’ ‘Hari’ with the names floats the three worlds

92Knowing this, Rāhu seized the moon, and the three worlds were flooded with the names “Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa! Hari!”

জয় জয় ধ্বনি হৈল সকল ভুবন ৷
চমৎকার হৈয়া লোক ভাবে মনে মন ॥ ৯৩ ॥

jaya jaya dhvani haila sakala bhuvana
‘glory glory’ the sound became in all the worlds
camatkāra haiyā loka bhāve mane mana
amazed becoming the people think within their minds

93Cries of “Jaya! Jaya!” rang through all the worlds, and the people, amazed, wondered within themselves.

জগৎ ভরিয়া লোক বলে — ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ ৷
সেইক্ষণে গৌরকৃষ্ণ ভূমে অবতরি ॥ ৯৪ ॥

jagat bhariyā loka bale — ‘hari’ ‘hari’
the world filling the people say — ‘Hari’ ‘Hari’
sei-kṣaṇe gaurakṛṣṇa bhūme avatari
at that moment Gaura-Kṛṣṇa on the earth descended

94The whole world was filled with people crying, “Hari! Hari!” — and at that very moment Gaura-Kṛṣṇa descended to the earth.

প্রসন্ন হইল সব জগতের মন ৷
‘হরি’ বলি’ হিন্দুকে হাস্য করয়ে যবন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

prasanna haila saba jagatera mana
glad became all of the world the mind
‘hari’ bali’ hinduke hāsya karaye yavana
‘Hari’ saying at the Hindus mockery makes the Muslim

95Every heart in the world was glad; even the Muslims, mocking the Hindus, cried out, “Hari!”21

‘হরি’ বলি’ নারীগণ দেই হুলাহুলি ৷
স্বর্গে বাদ্য-নৃত্য করে দেব কুতূহলী ॥ ৯৬ ॥

‘hari’ bali’ nārīgaṇa dei hulāhuli
‘Hari’ saying the women give ululation
svarge vādya-nṛtya kare deva kutūhalī
in heaven music and dance make the gods eager

96Calling “Hari!”, the women raised their joyful ululation, while in heaven the gods, full of eager delight, played music and danced.

প্রসন্ন হৈল দশ দিক্, প্রসন্ন নদীজল ৷
স্থাবর-জঙ্গম হৈল আনন্দে বিহ্বল ॥ ৯৭ ॥

prasanna haila daśa dik, prasanna nadījala
bright became the ten directions, clear the river water
sthāvara-jaṅgama haila ānande vihvala
the unmoving and the moving became with bliss overwhelmed

97The ten directions grew bright, the waters of the rivers grew clear, and all beings, moving and unmoving, were overwhelmed with bliss.

নদীয়া-উদয়গিরি, পূর্ণচন্দ্র গৌরহরি,
কৃপা করি’ হইল উদয় ৷
পাপ-তমো হৈল নাশ, ত্রিজগতের উল্লাস,
জগভরি’ হরিধ্বনি হয় ॥ ৯৮ ॥

nadīyā-udayagiri, pūrṇacandra gaurahari,
Nadīyā the eastern mountain, the full moon Gaurahari
kṛpā kari’ haila udaya
mercy showing has risen
pāpa-tamo haila nāśa, tri-jagatera ullāsa,
of sin the darkness became destroyed, of the three worlds the joy
jagabhari’ hari-dhvani haya
the world filling the sound of ‘Hari’ is

98Over Nadīyā, the eastern mountain, the full moon Gaurahari has risen in His mercy. The darkness of sin is destroyed, the three worlds rejoice, and the sound of “Hari!” fills the world.

সেইকালে নিজালয়, উঠিয়া অদ্বৈত রায়,
নৃত্য করে আনন্দিত-মনে ৷
হরিদাসে লঞা সঙ্গে, হুঙ্কার-কীর্ত্তন-রঙ্গে
কেনে নাচে, কেহ নাহি জানে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

sei-kāle nijālaya, uṭhiyā advaita rāya,
at that time in His own home, rising Advaita Rāya
nṛtya kare ānandita-mane
dance does joyful at heart
haridāse lañā saṅge, huṅkāra-kīrtana-raṅge
Haridāsa taking with Him, in the delight of roaring kīrtana
kene nāce, keha nāhi jāne
why He dances, anyone not knows

99At that very time, in His own home, Advaita Rāya rose and began to dance, joyful at heart. With Haridāsa beside Him He roared and sang kīrtana in delight — and no one knew why He was dancing.22

দেখি’ উপরাগ হাসি’, শীঘ্র গঙ্গাঘাটে আসি’,
আনন্দে করিল গঙ্গাস্নান ৷
পাঞা উপরাগ-ছলে, আপনার মনোবলে,
ব্রাহ্মণেরে দিল নানা দান ॥ ১০০ ॥

dekhi’ uparāga hāsi’, śīghra gaṅgā-ghāṭe āsi’,
seeing the eclipse laughing, quickly to the Gaṅgā’s bathing place coming
ānande karila gaṅgā-snāna
in joy made bath in the Gaṅgā
pāñā uparāga-chale, āpanāra mano-bale,
taking the eclipse as pretext, His own by the power of mind
brāhmaṇere dila nānā dāna
to the brāhmaṇas gave various gifts

100Seeing the eclipse, He laughed, hurried to the bathing place on the Gaṅgā and bathed there joyfully. Then, as though for the eclipse, He gave the brāhmaṇas many gifts in His mind.23

জগৎ আনন্দময়, দেখি’ মনে সবিস্ময়,
ঠারেঠোরে কহে হরিদাস ৷
তোমার ঐছন রঙ্গ, মোর মন পরসন্ন,
দেখি — কিছু কার্য্যে আছে ভাস ॥ ১০১ ॥

jagat ānandamaya, dekhi’ mane sa-vismaya,
the world full of bliss, seeing in mind astonished
ṭhāreṭhore kahe haridāsa
by hints says Haridāsa
tomāra aichana raṅga, mora mana parasanna,
Your such delight, my mind is pleased
dekhi — kichu kārye āche bhāsa
I see — some in the deed there is a hint

101Seeing the whole world full of bliss, Haridāsa was astonished and spoke in hints: “This joyful play of Yours delights my heart. I see that something lies behind it.”

আচার্যরত্ন, শ্রীবাস, হৈল মনে সুখোল্লাস,
যাই’ স্নান কৈল গঙ্গা-জলে ৷
আনন্দে বিহ্বল মন, করে হরিসংকীর্ত্তন,
নানা দান কৈল মনোবলে ॥ ১০২ ॥

ācāryaratna, śrīvāsa, haila mane sukhollāsa
Ācāryaratna, Śrīvāsa, became in mind joyful
yāi’ snāna kaila gaṅgā-jale
going bath made in the Gaṅgā’s water
ānande vihvala mana, kare hari-saṁkīrtana
with bliss overwhelmed mind, do saṅkīrtana of Hari
nānā dāna kaila mano-bale
various gifts made by the power of mind

102Ācāryaratna and Śrīvāsa were filled with joy. They went and bathed in the Gaṅgā, and, overwhelmed with bliss, sang the saṅkīrtana of Hari and gave many gifts in their minds.

এই মত ভক্তযতি, যাঁর যেই দেশে স্থিতি,
তাঁহা তাঁহা পাঞা মনোবলে ৷
নাচে, করে সংকীর্ত্তন, আনন্দে বিহ্বল মন,
দান করে গ্রহণের ছলে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

ei mata bhakta-yati, yām̐ra yei deśe sthiti,
in this way the devotees all, whose in whatever land dwelling
tām̐hā tām̐hā pāñā mano-bale
there there using power of mind
nāce, kare saṁkīrtana, ānande vihvala mana,
dance, do saṅkīrtana, with bliss overwhelmed the mind
dāna kare grahaṇera chale
gifts give on the pretext of the eclipse

103So too all the devotees, in whatever land they dwelt, danced and sang saṅkīrtana there, overwhelmed with bliss, and, as though for the eclipse, gave gifts in their minds.

ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন-নারী, নানা-দ্রব্যে পাত্র ভরি’
আইলা সবে যৌতুক লইয়া ৷
যেন কাঁচা-সোণা-দ্যুতি, দেখি, বালকের মূর্ত্তি,
আশীর্ব্বাদ করে সুখ পাঞা ॥ ১০৪ ॥

brāhmaṇa-sajjana-nārī, nānā-dravye pātra bhari’
brāhmaṇas, good men, women, with various things plates filling
āilā sabe yautuka laiyā
came all gifts taking
yena kām̐cā-soṇā-dyuti, dekhi, bālakera mūrti,
like molten gold the radiance, seeing the child’s form
āśīrvāda kare sukha pāñā
blessings give joy obtaining

104Brāhmaṇas, good men and women all came with plates heaped with gifts, and when they saw the child, radiant as molten gold, they blessed Him with delight.

সাবিত্রী, গৌরী, সরস্বতী, শচী, রম্ভা, অরুন্ধতী,
আর যত দেব-নারীগণ ৷
নানা-দ্রব্যে পাত্র ভরি’, ব্রাহ্মণীর বেশ ধরি’,
আসি’ সবে করেন দরশন ॥ ১০৫ ॥

sāvitrī, gaurī, sarasvatī, śacī, rambhā, arundhatī,
Sāvitrī, Gaurī, Sarasvatī, Śacī, Rambhā, Arundhatī
āra yata deva-nārīgaṇa
and all the wives of the gods
nānā-dravye pātra bhari’, brāhmaṇīra veśa dhari’,
with various things plates filling, of brāhmaṇa women the dress assuming
āsi’ sabe karena daraśana
coming all do seeing

105Sāvitrī, Gaurī, Sarasvatī, Śacī, Rambhā, Arundhatī and all the other goddesses came dressed as brāhmaṇa ladies, bearing trays laden with gifts, to see Him.24

অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ, সিদ্ধ, গন্ধর্ব্ব, চারণ,
স্তুতি-নৃত্য করে বাদ্য-গীত ৷
নর্ত্তক, বাদক, ভাট, নবদ্বীপে যার নাট,
সবে আসি’ নাচে পাঞা প্রীত ॥ ১০৬ ॥

antarīkṣe deva-gaṇa, siddha, gandharva, cāraṇa,
in the sky the gods, siddhas, gandharvas, cāraṇas
stuti-nṛtya kare vādya-gīta
praises dance make, music song
nartaka, vādaka, bhāṭa, navadvīpe yāra nāṭa,
dancers, musicians, bards, in Navadvīpa whose stage
sabe āsi’ nāce pāñā prīta
all coming dance delight obtaining

106In the sky the gods, siddhas, gandharvas and cāraṇas offered praises, danced, played and sang; and the dancers, musicians and bards who performed in Navadvīpa all came and danced with delight.

কেবা আসে কেবা যায়, কেবা নাচে কেবা গায়,
সম্ভালিতে নারে কার বোল ৷
খণ্ডিলেক দুঃখ-শোক, প্রমোদপূরিত লোক,
মিশ্র হৈলা আনন্দে বিহ্বল ॥ ১০৭ ॥

kebā āse kebā yāya, kebā nāce kebā gāya,
who comes, who goes, who dances, who sings
sambhālite nāre kāra bola
to make out cannot anyone’s words
khaṇḍileka duḥkha-śoka, pramoda-pūrita loka,
was cut off sorrow grief, with gladness filled the people
miśra hailā ānande vihvala
Miśra became with bliss overwhelmed

107Who was coming, who going, who dancing, who singing — no one could make out anyone’s words. Sorrow and grief were cut away, the people were filled with gladness, and Miśra was overwhelmed with bliss.25

আচার্য্যরত্ন, শ্রীনিবাস, জগন্নাথমিশ্র-পাশ,
আসি’ তাঁরে করে সাবধান ৷
করাইল জাতকর্ম্ম, যে আছিল বিধি-ধর্ম্ম,
তবে মিশ্র করে নানা দান ॥ ১০৮ ॥

ācāryaratna, śrīnivāsa, jagannātha-miśra-pāśa,
Ācāryaratna, Śrīnivāsa, Jagannātha Miśra’s side
āsi’ tām̐re kare sāvadhāna
coming him make attentive
karāila jātakarma, ye āchila vidhi-dharma,
had performed the birth rite, which was the rule of dharma
tabe miśra kare nānā dāna
then Miśra makes various gifts

108Ācāryaratna and Śrīvāsa came to Jagannātha Miśra and recalled him to his duty. They had the birth rite performed as the scriptures prescribe, and then Miśra gave many gifts.

যৌতুক পাইল যত, ঘরে বা আছিল কত,
সব ধন বিপ্রে দিল দান ৷
যত নর্ত্তক, গায়ন, ভাট, অকিঞ্চন জন,
ধন দিয়া কৈল সবার মান ॥ ১০৯ ॥

yautuka pāila yata, ghare vā āchila kata,
gifts received as many, in the house or was whatever
saba dhana vipre dila dāna
all wealth to the brāhmaṇas gave in charity
yata nartaka, gāyana, bhāṭa, akiñcana jana,
all dancers, singers, bards, destitute people
dhana diyā kaila sabāra māna
wealth giving made of all the honour

109He gave away to the brāhmaṇas all the gifts he had received and whatever else was in the house, and he honoured all the dancers, singers, bards and the poor with gifts of wealth.

শ্রীবাসের ব্রাহ্মণী, নাম তাঁর ‘মালিনী’,
আচার্য্যরত্নের পত্নী-সঙ্গে ৷
সিন্দূর, হরিদ্রা, তৈল, খই, কলা, নানা ফল,
দিয়া পূজে নারীগণ রঙ্গে ॥ ১১০ ॥

śrīvāsera brāhmaṇī, nāma tām̐ra ‘mālinī’,
Śrīvāsa’s wife, name her ‘Mālinī’
ācāryaratnera patnī-saṅge
of Ācāryaratna the wife with
sindūra, haridrā, taila, khai, kalā, nānā phala,
vermilion, turmeric, oil, puffed rice, bananas, various fruits
diyā pūje nārīgaṇa raṅge
giving worship the women in delight

110Śrīvāsa’s wife, whose name was Mālinī, came with the wife of Ācāryaratna, and the women joyfully worshipped the child with vermilion, turmeric, oil, puffed rice, bananas and many kinds of fruit.26

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য্য-ভার্য্যা, জগৎপূজিতা আর্য্যা,
নাম তাঁর ‘সীতা ঠাকুরাণী’ ৷
আচার্য্যের আজ্ঞা পাঞা, গেলা উপহার লঞা,
দেখিতে বালক-শিরোমণি ॥ ১১১ ॥

advaita-ācārya-bhāryā, jagat-pūjitā āryā,
Advaita Ācārya’s wife, by the world revered noble lady
nāma tām̐ra ‘sītā ṭhākurāṇī’
name her ‘Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī’
ācāryera ājñā pāñā, gelā upahāra lañā,
the Ācārya’s order receiving, went gifts taking
dekhite bālaka-śiromaṇi
to see of children the crown jewel

111Advaita Ācārya’s wife, the noble lady revered by all the world, was named Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī. With the Ācārya’s leave she set out with gifts to see that jewel among children.

সুবর্ণের কড়ি-বউলি, রজতমুদ্রা-পাশুলি,
সুবর্ণের অঙ্গদ, কঙ্কণ ৷
দু-বাহুতে দিব্য শঙ্খ, রজতের মলবঙ্ক,
স্বর্ণমুদ্রার নানা হারগণ ॥ ১১২ ॥

suvarṇera kaḍi-ba-uli, rajatamudrā-pāśuli,
of gold the waist-chain, of silver coins anklets
suvarṇera aṅgada, kaṅkaṇa
of gold armlets, bracelets
du-bāhute divya śaṅkha, rajatera malabaṅka,
on both arms fine conch bangles, of silver ankle-rings
svarṇa-mudrāra nānā hāragaṇa
of gold coins various necklaces

112She brought a little golden waist-chain and anklets of silver coins, golden armlets and bracelets, fine conch-shell bangles for both arms, silver ankle-rings and necklaces of gold coins.

ব্যাঘ্রনখ হেমজড়ি, কটি-পট্টসূত্র-ডোরী,
হস্ত-পদের যত আভরণ ৷
চিত্রবর্ণ পট্টসাড়ী, বুনি ফোতো পট্টপাড়ী,
স্বর্ণ-রৌপ্য-মুদ্রা বহুধন ॥ ১১৩ ॥

vyāghra-nakha hema-jaḍi, kaṭi-paṭṭasūtra-ḍorī,
tiger’s claw set in gold, for the waist silk cord
hasta-padera yata ābharaṇa
of hands and feet all ornaments
citra-varṇa paṭṭa-sāḍī, buni photo paṭṭapāḍī,
many-coloured silk saris, woven little shirt with silk border
svarṇa-raupya-mudrā bahu-dhana
gold silver coins much wealth

113There was also a tiger’s claw set in gold, a silken waist-cord, every kind of ornament for hands and feet, many-coloured silk saris, a little shirt woven with a silk border, and a wealth of gold and silver coins.27

দুর্ব্বা, ধান্য, গোরোচন, হরিদ্রা, কুঙ্কুম, চন্দন,
মঙ্গল-দ্রব্য পাত্র ভরিয়া ৷
বস্ত্র-গুপ্ত দোলা চড়ি’, সঙ্গে লঞা দাসী-চেড়ী,
বস্ত্রালঙ্কার পেটারি ভরিয়া ॥ ১১৪ ॥

durvā, dhānya, gorocana, haridrā, kuṅkuma, candana,
dūrvā grass, paddy, gorocanā, turmeric, saffron, sandal
maṅgala-dravya pātra bhariyā
with auspicious things plates filling
vastra-gupta dolā caḍi’, saṅge lañā dāsī-ceḍī,
with cloth covered palanquin riding, with her taking maidservants
vastrālaṅkāra peṭāri bhariyā
clothes and ornaments baskets filling

114Riding in a curtained palanquin with her maidservants, she came with baskets full of clothes and ornaments, and plates heaped with auspicious things — dūrvā grass, paddy, gorocanā, turmeric, saffron and sandal.28

ভক্ষ্য, ভোজ্য উপহার, সঙ্গে লইল বহু ভার,
শচীগৃহে হৈল উপনীত ৷
দেখিয়া বালক-ঠাম, সাক্ষাৎ গোকুল-কান,
বর্ণমাত্র দেখি বিপরীত ॥ ১১৫ ॥

bhakṣya, bhojya upahāra, saṅge laila bahu bhāra,
food to chew, food to eat, gifts, with her took many loads
śacī-gṛhe haila upanīta
to Śacī’s house became arrived
dekhiyā bālaka-ṭhāma, sākṣāt gokula-kāna,
seeing the child’s form, very Kāna of Gokula
varṇamātra dekhi viparīta
the colour only seeing the opposite

115Bringing many loads of sweets and other foods, she arrived at Śacī’s house. When she saw the child, He was Kāna of Gokula Himself — only His colour was the opposite.29

সর্ব্ব অঙ্গ — সুনির্ম্মাণ, সুবর্ণ-প্রতিমা-ভান,
সর্ব্ব অঙ্গ — সুলক্ষণময় ৷
বালকের দিব্য জ্যোতি, দেখি’ পাইল বহু প্রীতি,
বাৎসল্যেতে দ্রবিল হৃদয় ॥ ১১৬ ॥

sarva aṅga — sunirmāṇa, suvarṇa-pratimā-bhāna,
every limb — finely formed, a golden image seeming
sarva aṅga — sulakṣaṇamaya
every limb — with auspicious marks full
bālakera divya jyoti, dekhi’ pāila bahu prīti,
of the child the divine radiance, seeing she got much delight
vātsalyete dravila hṛdaya
with parental love melted her heart

116Every limb was finely formed, He seemed an image of gold, and every limb bore auspicious marks. Seeing the child’s divine radiance, she was filled with delight, and her heart melted with a mother’s love.

দুর্ব্বা ধান্য দিল শীর্ষে, কৈল বহু আশীষে,
চিরজীবী হও দুই ভাই ৷
ডাকিনী-শাঁখিনী হৈতে, শঙ্কা উপজিল চিতে,
ডরে নাম থুইল ‘নিমাই’ ॥ ১১৭ ॥

durvā dhānya dila śīrṣe, kaila bahu āśīṣe,
dūrvā paddy placed on His head, made many blessings
cirajīvī hao dui bhāi
long-lived be the two brothers
ḍākinī-śām̐khinī haite, śaṅkā upajila cite,
of ḍākinīs and śākhinīs from, fear arose in her heart
ḍare nāma thuila ‘nimāi’
out of fear the name gave ‘Nimāi’

117She placed dūrvā grass and paddy on His head and blessed Him again and again: “May the two brothers live long!” Fearing the witches and evil spirits, she gave Him the name Nimāi.30

পুত্রমাতা-স্নানদিনে, দিল বস্ত্র বিভূষণে,
পুত্র-সহ মিশ্রেরে সম্মানি’ ৷
শচী-মিশ্রের পূজা লঞা, মনেতে হরিষ হঞা,
ঘরে আইলা সীতা-ঠাকুরাণী ॥ ১১৮ ॥

putramātā-snānadine, dila vastra vibhūṣaṇe,
the son and mother’s bathing day, gave clothes ornaments
putra-saha miśrere sammāni’
with the son Miśra honouring
śacī-miśrera pūjā lañā, manete hariṣa hañā,
Śacī and Miśra’s honour receiving, in mind glad becoming
ghare āilā sītā-ṭhākurāṇī
home returned Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī

118On the day the mother and child were bathed, she gave them clothes and ornaments and honoured Miśra together with his son. Then, honoured in turn by Śacī and Miśra, Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī returned home glad at heart.31

ঐছে শচী-জগন্নাথ, পুত্র পাঞা লক্ষ্মীনাথ,
পূর্ণ হইল সকল বাঞ্ছিত ৷
ধন-ধান্যে ভরে ঘর, লোকমান্য-কলেবর,
দিনে দিনে হয় আনন্দিত ॥ ১১৯ ॥

aiche śacī-jagannātha, putra pāñā lakṣmīnātha,
thus Śacī and Jagannātha, a son obtaining, the Lord of Lakṣmī
pūrṇa haila sakala vāñchita
fulfilled became all desires
dhana-dhānye bhare ghara, lokamānya-kalevara,
with wealth and grain is filled the house, honoured by all the body
dine dine haya ānandita
day by day become joyful

119So Śacī and Jagannātha had gained a son who was the Lord of Lakṣmī, and all their desires were fulfilled. Their house was filled with wealth and grain; everyone honoured their child, and day by day their joy grew.

মিশ্র — বৈষ্ণব, শান্ত, অলম্পট, শুদ্ধ, দান্ত,
ধনভোগে নাহি অভিমান ৷
পুত্রের প্রভাবে যত, ধন আসি’ মিলে তত,
বিষ্ণুপ্রীতে দ্বিজে দেন দান ॥ ১২০ ॥

miśra — vaiṣṇava, śānta, alampaṭa, śuddha, dānta,
Miśra — a Vaiṣṇava, peaceful, free from lust, pure, self-controlled
dhana-bhoge nāhi abhimāna
in enjoying wealth not conceit
putrera prabhāve yata, dhana āsi’ mile tata,
by the son’s power as much wealth coming is gained so much
viṣṇu-prīte dvije dena dāna
for Viṣṇu’s pleasure to brāhmaṇas gives in charity

120Miśra was a Vaiṣṇava — peaceful, free from lust, pure and self-controlled — with no thought of enjoying wealth. Whatever wealth came to him through his son’s power, he gave to the brāhmaṇas for the pleasure of Viṣṇu.32

লগ্ন গণি’ হর্ষমতি, নীলাম্বর চক্রবর্ত্তী,
গুপ্তে কিছু কহিল মিশ্রেরে ৷
মহাপুরুষের চিহ্ন, লগ্নে অঙ্গে ভিন্ন ভিন্ন,
দেখি, — এই তারিবে সংসারে ॥ ১২১ ॥

lagna gaṇi’ harṣamati, nīlāmbara cakravartī,
the ascendant calculating joyful at heart, Nīlāmbara Cakravartī
gupte kichu kahila miśrere
in secret something said to Miśra
mahāpuruṣera cihna, lagne aṅge bhinna bhinna,
of a great person the marks, in the horoscope on the body various
dekhi, — ei tāribe saṁsāre
I see — this one will deliver the world

121Nīlāmbara Cakravartī cast the horoscope with joy in his heart and told Miśra in secret, “I see many marks of a great person (mahāpuruṣa), both in the horoscope and on His body. This child will deliver the world.”33

ঐছে প্রভু শচী-ঘরে, কৃপায় কৈল অবতারে,
যেই ইহা করয়ে শ্রবণ ৷
গৌরপ্রভু দয়াময়, তাঁরে হয়েন সদয়,
সেই পায় তাঁহার চরণ ॥ ১২২ ॥

aiche prabhu śacī-ghare, kṛpāya kaila avatāre,
thus the Lord in Śacī’s house in mercy made descent
yei ihā karaye śravaṇa
whoever this does hearing
gaura-prabhu dayāmaya, tām̐re hayena sadaya,
Gaura Prabhu merciful, to him becomes kind
sei pāya tām̐hāra caraṇa
he attains His feet

122Thus the Lord in His mercy descended in Śacī’s house. Whoever hears of this receives the kindness of merciful Gaura Prabhu and attains His feet.

পাইয়া মানুষ-জন্ম, যে না শুনে গৌরগুণ,
হেন জন্ম তার ব্যর্থ হৈল ৷
পাইয়া অমৃতধুনী, পিয়ে বিষগর্ত্ত-পানি,
জন্মিয়া সে কেনে নাহি মৈল ॥ ১২৩ ॥

pāiyā mānuṣa-janma, ye nā śune gaura-guṇa,
having obtained human birth, who not hears Gaura’s qualities
hena janma tāra vyartha haila
such birth his wasted became
pāiyā amṛtadhunī, piye viṣa-garta-pāni,
having found the river of nectar, drinks from a poison pit water
janmiyā se kene nāhi maila
being born he why not died

123One who has gained a human birth yet will not hear of Gaura’s qualities has wasted that birth. He has found the river of nectar, yet drinks water from a poisoned pit. Why did he not die as soon as he was born?34

124Honouring upon my head, as my own treasure, the holy feet of Śrī Caitanya and Nityānanda, Ācārya Advaitacandra, Svarūpa, Rūpa and Raghunātha dāsa, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, have sung the pastime of His birth.

Notes

  1. Heading in the edition: “The rays of hari-bhajana shining from the devotee-moons destroy the darkness of the living beings’ ignorance.”
  2. Heading in the edition to 15–16: Murāri Gupta strung together the Ādi-līlā in his Caitanya-carita, and Svarūpa Dāmodara the later pastimes in his Kaḍacā (diary).
  3. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Śrī Murāri Gupta’s notes on the Ādi-līlā still survive; the Vaiṣṇavas read them, and they heard the notes of Śrī Svarūpa Gosvāmī’s diary from the lips of Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī — and so they describe the Lord’s pastimes.
  4. Anubhāṣya: on this full moon Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya — the Lord of Goloka, the original source of all avatāras, in whom Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are one — descended together with the names of Kṛṣṇa from His own abode, the Gaura-prakoṣṭha, into the earthly Navadvīpa; and the full moon itself is no worldly day but a transcendental goddess of the lunar day (tithi), who descended into time to serve Him. The Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya cites a verse: “In the twenty-eighth age of Vaivasvata Manu, in the year fourteen hundred and seven, on the lovely bank of the Bhāgīrathī, from the great ocean of Śacī’s womb, on a full moon seized by Rāhu, Gaurāṅga appeared.”
  5. Heading in the edition: “Crying on the pretext of making people chant the name — and quieting at the name alone.”
  6. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: while teaching His pupils the sūtras of grammar with their vṛtti and ṭīkā, the Lord taught them the purport of Kṛṣṇa’s name; following that teaching, the Gosvāmīs (Śrī Jīva) later composed two grammars, the Laghu- and the Bṛhad-Harināmāmṛta-vyākaraṇa, through which one gains both a knowledge of words and devotion to Kṛṣṇa.
  7. Heading in the edition to 34–36: “Of the last twenty-four years in Nīlācala, six were spent preaching the name and prema from the ocean to the Himalayas.”
  8. Anubhāṣya: one in whom prema has awakened dwells in the transcendental rasa of separation (vipralambha), which nourishes the rasa of union (sambhoga); without separation union finds no fullness. This state of love Śrī Gaurasundara taught the souls of the world, in order to taste it Himself.
  9. Anubhāṣya: Vidyāpati, Jayadeva and Caṇḍīdāsa sang of the transcendental rasa of separation, and the Lord, absorbed in the heart of Śrī Rādhā, relished their songs with His two most intimate devotees, Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya. But for those who identify with the body, who look in these songs for worldly poetry, or who, like the prākṛta-sahajiyās, claim to follow rāgānugā in order to please their senses, any discussion of the pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa is strictly forbidden: they would take those transcendental pastimes for worldly love and ruin themselves.
  10. Heading in the edition: “On the basis of those notes Ṭhākura Vṛndāvana dāsa described the pastimes of Gaura.”
  11. Anubhāṣya (after the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā, 35): the cowherd Parjanya, Kṛṣṇa’s grandfather, appeared in Śrīhaṭṭa as Upendra Miśra, the father of seven sons; he lived in the village of Ḍhākā-dakṣiṇa.
  12. Heading in the edition: “Who Jagannātha was in the avatāra of Kṛṣṇa.”
  13. Anubhāṣya (after the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā, 104): Nīlāmbara Cakravartī is the sage Garga, for, like Garga with Kṛṣṇa, he foretold in an assembly the coming appearance of Gaura; and as Śacī’s father he is the cowherd Sumukha.
  14. Heading in the edition: “The teaching that devotion to Kṛṣṇa alone is the means (abhidheya).”
  15. Anubhāṣya to 67–71: see Ādi 3.95–109 and the Caitanya-bhāgavata, Ādi 2.
  16. Heading in the edition: “Viśvarūpa is Mahā-saṅkarṣaṇa of Vaikuṇṭha.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Viśvarūpa is the avatāra of Mahā-saṅkarṣaṇa of the spiritual sky. Anubhāṣya: Viśvarūpa, the elder brother of Śrī Gaurahari, took sannyāsa before marriage, receiving the name Śaṅkarāraṇya, and in Śaka 1431 passed from view at Pandharpur; He is both the material and the efficient cause of the universe. According to the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā (58–59), Viśvarūpa is the vyūha Saṅkarṣaṇa, while Nityānanda Avadhūta is Baladeva Himself, the Balarāma of Vraja.
  17. Anubhāṣya: Śukadeva says this to Parīkṣit about Baladeva’s slaying of the demon Dhenuka.
  18. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Mahā-saṅkarṣaṇa, the material and the efficient cause, pervades the universe through and through, and therefore Mahāprabhu calls Viśvarūpa His elder brother; but the Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma of Kṛṣṇa’s own abode are Caitanya and Nitāi, and so Nityānanda Prabhu is the original Saṅkarṣaṇa, Baladeva Himself.
  19. Anubhāṣya to 80–86: Jagannātha and Śacī are the Lord’s eternal associates (nitya-siddha); their hearts and bodies are made of pure goodness (śuddha-sattva) and are not like those of ordinary living beings. Pure goodness is called vasudeva, and in it Vāsudeva, who eternally enjoys His spiritual pastimes, becomes manifest. The union of Jagannātha and Śacī and the conception in Śacī’s womb were not like the carnal union and pregnancy of worldly people; even to think so is an offence. According to the Bhāgavatam (10.2.16–18, with the comments of Śrīdhara Svāmī and Baladeva Vidyābhūṣaṇa) and the Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta, Kṛṣṇa first became manifest in the heart of Vasudeva, and from his heart in the heart of Devakī; so too Śrī Gaurasundara appeared in the hearts of Miśra and Śacī, wholly absorbed as they were in serving the feet of Govinda (13.79).
  20. Anubhāṣya: the ṣaḍ-varga are the six divisions of a sign — kṣetra, horā, drekkāṇa, navāṁśa, dvādaśāṁśa and triṁśāṁśa; by them Cakravartī determined the auspicious signs. The aṣṭa-varga is reckoned from the positions of the planets, as taught in the Bṛhaj-jātaka and other books; by this reckoning too he found Mahāprabhu’s signs auspicious.
  21. Heading in the edition: “Then even the Muslims took the name of Hari, on the pretext of mockery.”
  22. Anubhāṣya: His own home — in Śāntipura; on the day of the Lord’s appearance Haridāsa Ṭhākura was in Śāntipura.
  23. Anubhāṣya: mano-bale — “with eagerness of heart”, or “in the mind”. So too Vasudeva, seeing Hari born as his son, in the joy of Kṛṣṇa’s birth festival gave the brāhmaṇas ten thousand cows in his mind (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 10.3.11).
  24. Anubhāṣya: Sāvitrī is the consort of Brahmā, Gaurī of Śiva, Sarasvatī of Nṛsiṁha (after the verse quoted by Śrīdhara Svāmī: “in whose mouth dwells the Goddess of speech and on whose breast Lakṣmī…”), Śacī of Indra; Rambhā is a dancer of heaven, and Arundhatī the wife of Vasiṣṭha.
  25. Anubhāṣya: sambhālite — “to understand”; gods, men, siddhas and the rest belong to different orders of beings, and so could not understand one another’s speech.
  26. Heading in the edition: “The auspicious rites of Mālinī Ṭhākurāṇī and the Lord’s aunt”: the wife of Candraśekhara (Ācāryaratna) was Śacī’s sister.
  27. Anubhāṣya to 112–113: kaḍi-bauli — a golden waist-chain; pāśuli — a silver foot ornament; aṅgada, kaṅkaṇa — golden bracelets; divya śaṅkha — bangles of conch shell; malabaṅka — a curved ankle-ring; hema-jaḍi — a jewel set in gold with a tiger’s claw; kaṭi-paṭṭasūtra-ḍorī — a waist-cord; citra-varṇa paṭṭa-sāḍī — many-coloured silk cloth; buni photo paṭṭa-pāḍī — a child’s little shirt (phatuyā) with a woven silk border.
  28. Anubhāṣya: gorocanā — a bright yellow auspicious substance found in a cow’s head; kuṅkuma — the fragrant saffron of Kashmir.
  29. Anubhāṣya: Kāna, Kānu — Kṛṣṇa; Kṛṣṇa’s colour is the deep blue of a rain-cloud or a sapphire, while Viśvambhara’s is the opposite, golden.
  30. Anubhāṣya: the two brothers — Viśvarūpa and Viśvambhara; ḍākinī and śākhinī — evil spirits in the train of Pārvatī and Maheśa; they cannot approach the sacred nimba tree or anything connected with it — hence the name Nimāi.
  31. Anubhāṣya: the bathing day is the day when mother and child are first brought out of the house (niṣkramaṇa); the Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya names the fifth and the ninth day after the birth. By Bengali custom a relative who has visited a household is honoured with clothes on taking leave; so Jagannātha Miśra and Śacī honoured Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī, and she returned to Śāntipura.
  32. Anubhāṣya: worldly people, thinking of wife and children, are busy only with enjoying their wealth; the pure devotee Jagannātha Miśra was not like that: he offered everything to the Lord, gave the remnants to brāhmaṇas and other worthy persons, and took nothing for his own enjoyment.
  33. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the marks are in the horoscope and on the body (by sāmudrika, the science of bodily signs).
  34. Anubhāṣya: one who turns from the river of nectar — devotion to Kṛṣṇa — to drink from the poisoned well of sense pleasure, so harmful to the soul, is utterly foolish, and his life is not worth sustaining. The Anubhāṣya cites the Caitanya-candrāmṛta of Śrīla Prabodhānanda Sarasvatī: if the world does not worship Śrī Caitanya, the Lord whom the best of the immortals worship, it is lifeless and death awaits it on every side; and now that the moon of Caitanya has risen and the ocean of the nectar of great love has spread far and wide, whoever remains poor is poor indeed.
